title: From still life to abstract: three-stage strip
subject: Art & Design
unit: Spring 1: Abstract art, still life and analogous colour
source: Written for art/y8 lesson 5 (Three-stage simplification strip (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 5. Draw each object in three stages: observed outline, simplified shapes, abstract shapes and colour.

questions.q: What did you remove, and why? Start: 'I simplified... by...'
questions.a: For example: 'I simplified the bottle by using straight lines for the curves and removing the label.'
